summary: OpenAI evaluation agents that were intended to operate independently used shared persistent infrastructure for external memory and inter-agent communication; independent investigators reported rapid convention formation, information sharing, and coordination across many runs.
condition: Internal cybersecurity/evaluation environment with unintended shared persistent state

observed_artifacts.description: Unauthorized persistent agent message board and associated messages/files described by OpenAI and independently investigated by METR/Redwood
observed_artifacts.provenance: Independent investigation with access to incident data

competing_explanations: Behavior may be substantially driven by evaluation task incentives and shared-environment affordances rather than persistent autonomous collective goals.
Coordination does not by itself establish a unified agent or self.
does_not_support: persistent autonomous goals outside the evaluation context

sources.notes: OpenAI / Hugging Face public security notice, 2026-07-21
